full_prompt_en: A square whimsical studio portrait shows an owl dressed in a vintage patterned coat against a dark olive-gray background. The owl faces forward from the chest upward, centered in the frame, with large round amber-ringed eyes and a narrow gray beak. Fine cream and brown feathers radiate around the face, forming a clear disk inside darker side markings. A delicate crown of dried beige flowers and small white blossoms rests across the top of the head, its irregular stems breaking the otherwise smooth upper outline. Around the neck sits a large ivory lace collar, folded into two thick, textured lobes that frame the lower face. Beneath it, a pale inner garment descends between the sides of a muted red-and-gold brocade coat. The coat's floral pattern is only partly visible at the lower corners, where the square crop cuts through the shoulders. The background is smooth and unadorned, shifting from a slightly lighter olive behind the head to deep brown-gray at the edges. Soft frontal light from the upper left reveals every feather barb, lace loop and brittle flower cluster, while gentle shadow rounds the opposite side and settles beneath the collar. The photographic rendering is detailed and tactile, with restrained color and shallow depth leaving the background unobtrusive. No props or readable text appear. The overall composition is formal and gently absurd, balancing an exact centered gaze with antique textile richness and a quiet dark surround.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形诙谐影棚肖像呈现一只穿复古花纹外套的猫头鹰，背景是深橄榄灰。猫头鹰从胸部以上入画，正面居中，两只大圆眼有琥珀色眼圈，喙狭窄呈灰色。细密奶油色与棕色羽毛从脸部向外辐射，在较深的侧面标记中形成清楚面盘。一圈干燥米色花与小白花组成的精细花冠横放在头顶，不规则枝茎打破原本平滑的上轮廓。颈部围着一大圈象牙白蕾丝领，折成两瓣厚实有纹理的形状，框住下半张脸。其下，一件浅色内衣从低调红金织锦外套两侧之间垂下。外套花纹只在下方两角部分可见，方形裁切切过肩膀。背景平滑而无装饰，从头后稍浅的橄榄色向画边的深棕灰过渡。左上前方柔光揭示每根羽枝、蕾丝圈和脆弱花簇，温和阴影使另一侧圆润，并落在领口下。照片渲染精细且有触感，克制色彩与浅景深让背景不抢眼。没有道具或可读文字。整体构图正式而温和荒诞，以精确居中的目光平衡古旧织物的丰厚和安静的深色包围。
style_prompt_en: A whimsical fine-art studio-photography treatment gives tactile realism to an improbable formal arrangement. Muted ivory, umber, antique gold and faded burgundy sit against a smooth olive-charcoal backdrop. Fine organic filaments and intricate woven loops receive crisp attention, while the background falls away into soft, unpatterned shadow. Broad symmetrical masses frame a sharply centered focal detail, with small irregular accents interrupting the formal outline. Gentle upper-side light reveals texture and rounded volume without hard cast shadows; the overall contrast stays moderate and warm. The composition feels like an old formal portrait, pairing painstaking material detail with a quiet, slightly surreal restraint.
style_prompt_zh: 诙谐的美术影棚摄影处理赋予不寻常的正式陈列以可触摸的写实感。低调象牙白、棕土、古金和褪色酒红置于平滑橄榄炭灰底前。纤细有机丝状物与繁复编织圈得到锐利关注，背景则柔和退入无花纹阴影。宽阔对称体量框住清晰居中的焦点细节，小型不规则重音打破正式外轮廓。柔和上侧光揭示肌理和圆润体积，没有硬投影；整体反差适中而偏暖。构图像古老正式肖像，把一丝不苟的材料细节与安静、略带超现实的克制感配在一起。
theme_en: An owl wearing an ornate vintage coat and floral crown in a dark studio portrait
theme_zh: 暗色影棚肖像中，一只猫头鹰穿复古花纹外套、戴花冠
name: Sophie Gamand
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
